about_the_game:
Nebularena immerses you in futuristic PvP battles on space platforms, completely automated through your strategy.

You will create the ultimate ship that will confront the constructions of other players in deathmatches where anything goes:

  • Heavy armament: submachine gun, flamethrower, shotgun

  • Robotic drone factories: striker robot, detonator, protector...

  • Total destruction ammunition: bomb, rocket, explosive

Installations with rare energies: lasers, reflective shields...

You will also prepare your defenses and plan your resources in real time during automated confrontations:

  • Power production factories: electricity, fuel...

  • Movement of the platform and strategy: booster, command tower...

  • Optimization of building placements: bonus tower, zone boost...

Your construction choices will determine your strategy and automatic behavior of your platform. Be creative, bold, thoughtful... and set out to conquer the ladder of...

NEBULARENA - Warship - Building - Mastery

short_description: Build and expand your spaceship platform in this intense PvP auto-battler. Balance energy generation and consumption while constructing defenses and deploying new buildings. Destroy the core of the enemy ship and progress in a highly competitive ladder!
